issues.text: Four corrections, taken exactly as the reader gave them, break the file's own constraint of 18 words per phrase (app/test/unit/texts.test.js TX-2, TX-3, TX-8; the phrase is the text between .!?… marks): texts.idea_text (a sentence of 22 words), texts.how_interview_text (23), texts.how_spec_text (20) and texts.order_example_2_request (20). The order was to keep every constraint, so I kept the reader's words and split each into two sentences, adding at most three words: idea_text «Write in plain words who it is for. Say what a person needs to do and what they should see at the end. Do not worry …»; how_interview_text «… Each question comes with ready-made answers you can choose with one tap. There is also a “Not sure” option and a field for your own answer. …»; how_spec_text «… writes the first version of the requirements. It covers goals, screens, data, constraints and open questions. …»; order_example_2_request «“I want a catalog of about fifty products from my workshop. It needs search by name and a filter by type.”». The readers of round 2 should look at these four lines; if ORCH prefers one sentence with fewer words, it is a new task. The tests were not touched.
Nothing needed shortening for the width: «That’s enough, show the result» fits its slot at 320 px (e2e LD-1 green); the wording is exactly the reader's.

The files of the tree app/test/** were being edited by TEST-DESIGNER at the same time (app/test/e2e/landing.test.js and app/test/int/demo.test.js are modified in the working tree); the scratch clone carried that state of the tree as it was when copied, and all runs were green with it. No test file is touched by this work, and no test pins an old English value of the changed keys.

The sentence «Sending real emails and messenger messages» is now the same in nobuild_4 and order_cannot_3, as it was before (both lines had one wording); the intake lines of solutions[0] and solutions[5] includes[3] stay equal to each other as before.
